title: FolioKey · Lawful benchmarking and integration track
status: Local review draft; not merged or deployed
baseline: Local source 9be7ec3; previously deployed PR2 merge a6728b0. No fresh production inspection in this track.
scope: Seven public product benchmarks; nine public repositories at pinned commits. Static evidence review, not an independent product/security audit.
policy: Use public pages, official help/docs, permitted public flows and public repository material only. No private API scraping, auth bypass, decompilation, leaked repositories or proprietary code/UI/assets.
No paid provider/model calls, production DB mutations, merge or deployment in this track. Local documentation work only; review gates remain before implementation release.
Software license, dependency license, data redistribution rights, provider access contract and product/advisory eligibility are separate checks. Public visibility is not a blanket permission.
Keep FolioKey’s existing charcoal/lime and ivory/forest design tokens and original components; keep Supabase as the sole application authentication system.
Study requirements and general architecture; do not reconstruct proprietary scoring formulas, imitate exact screens, copy marketing text, or infer algorithms from private responses.
No external code, copyrighted screenshots, production financial records or third-party datasets are included in these deliverables. No external repository code was installed or executed.

Future reuse requires upstream URL, commit, exact file list, license evidence, dependency SBOM, NOTICE/attribution, modified-file notices where required, and an accountable reviewer. Unknown/absent permission means no code reuse.
Do not copy example tax rates, fund rankings, health scores, artificial histories or demonstration financial values into product output. Synthetic fixtures stay explicitly test-only.

competitors.name: Dezerv
competitors.observed: Wealth Monitor advertises portfolio red flags and review. The separate public overlap tool compares common equity holdings and fund characteristics.
competitors.limitation: Private scoring, weightings, paid access and live-account outcomes were not inspected. Abstention behavior was not verified.
competitors.pattern: Evidence-led findings: what changed, source/date, impact, limitations and a proportionate next step. Diversification and underperformance are separate findings.
competitors.gap: Only data coverage and simple concentration checks exist. Build category-relative review, dated look-through and recurring monitoring.

competitors.name: Groww
competitors.observed: Official help describes importing external funds through OTP into the dashboard; a public fund comparison page is available.
competitors.limitation: Help describes the user journey, not an API license or universal account coverage. No authenticated flow was exercised.
competitors.pattern: Short connect → review → tracker journey. Separate value, cash invested, gains and time-aware returns; compare like-for-like plans.
competitors.gap: CAS preview exists. Mobile-led provider aggregation, transaction-backed returns and a real comparison engine are missing.

competitors.name: ET Money
competitors.observed: Health review covers volatility, sector exposure, category-relative performance and investment behavior. Its methodology overview emphasizes consistency across longer history.
competitors.limitation: Exact attention/monitor/performing labels and monthly report delivery were not verified. Proprietary ratings/weights are unknown; do not replicate them.
competitors.pattern: Original review states: insufficient evidence, needs review, monitor, within stated criteria. Monthly in-app snapshots with explicit methodology and change reasons.
competitors.gap: No consistency engine, supported SIP-discipline measure or monthly analytical report. Do not infer missed SIPs from an incomplete statement.

competitors.name: Kuvera
competitors.observed: Public material describes goal/risk-oriented planning and recommendations. TradeSmart presents tax and exit-load context around transactions.
competitors.limitation: Some material is historical. Tax thresholds on marketing pages are not authoritative current law. Execution and recommendation internals were not inspected.
competitors.pattern: Separate risk capacity, tolerance, horizon and liquidity needs; connect goals to holdings; show estimated costs before any action.
competitors.gap: Risk/goals, lot-based tax, rebalance and execution are unavailable. Build planning before transaction execution.

competitors.name: INDmoney
competitors.observed: Advertises combined internal/external MF analytics: XIRR, dividends, allocation, underlying sectors and benchmark context.
competitors.limitation: Advertised analytics were not independently reconciled. The named import backend is not proof of availability to FolioKey.
competitors.pattern: Explain contributions versus investment growth; show coverage and per-fund attribution before an aggregate conclusion.
competitors.gap: Missing complete cashflows, dividend accounting, suitable benchmark comparisons and look-through allocation.

competitors.name: Paytm Money
competitors.observed: Official portfolio article describes AMC, fund-type, asset-allocation, sector and underlying-holdings views.
competitors.limitation: No authenticated app or data feed was inspected; availability and entitlements can vary.
competitors.pattern: Progressive disclosure: portfolio → fund → underlying exposure, with dates and readable mobile summaries.
competitors.gap: Basic AMC/category observations only; no dated underlying security/sector exposure.

competitors.name: Zerodha Coin
competitors.observed: Official help explains cashflow timing and shows access to portfolio XIRR on app and web.
competitors.limitation: No calculation code or private endpoints were inspected. A public explanation is not an independent numerical oracle.
competitors.pattern: Explain why absolute gain differs from annualised money-weighted return; make calculation coverage inspectable.
competitors.gap: No complete-ledger XIRR; do not average individual fund XIRRs into portfolio XIRR.

repositories.decision: Study high-level concepts only under this plan. No code port or vendoring without a separate copyleft compatibility decision.
repositories.pattern: Reconciliation as a first-class state; ledger completeness separate from valuation; local-first processing and reduced holdings leakage through bulk market data.
repositories.risk: AGPL network-source obligations may apply to a modified/combined service. A separate process is not automatic exemption. README privacy claims are not a security audit; local ownership assumptions do not replace multi-user RLS.
repositories.fit: High conceptual fit for PR2–PR3; original TypeScript implementation. Do not lift tax rules or UI.
repositories.depth: README, license and tree only; implementation files identified, not reviewed or executed.

contracts: Owner ID derived from session; owner-scoped account/folio; exact scheme/plan/option; event type; effective and posting dates; decimal-string units/amount; source row reference/hash; source schema version; correction/supersedes reference. PAN is not an authorization key.

Supported / partial / unavailable / conflicting; as-of and retrieved-at timestamps; method version; source IDs; missing requirements; coverage numerator/denominator. Used consistently from import to AI.
Period start/end, opening units and cost evidence, statement closing units, reconciliation tolerance, unresolved events, supported asset scope. A snapshot is never silently promoted to a full ledger.
Exact identity, effective mapping dates, value/date, provider/source, retrieval time, revision identity and quality status. No public feed automatically becomes a licensed commercial history service.

Observation and calculation inputs separated from advice; method/threshold version, comparable cohort/window, measured result, source dates, confidence in data coverage and explicit abstention reasons.
Owner, provider connection ID, consent scope/status/expiry, approved data period, last successful/partial refresh, idempotency keys and revocation state. Never persist OTP or raw CAS in logs.

prs.title: Benchmark evidence, reuse policy and release gates
prs.now: Ready for documentation review; added locally in this track.
prs.scope: Record source dates, pinned commits, license evidence, exclusions, acceptance cases and future PR boundaries. No external code or runtime dependency added.
prs.gate: Review matrix and exclusions; ensure every planned metric has data requirements and an unavailable state. No production mutation.

prs.title: Finish trustworthy import and account acceptance
prs.now: Can build/review locally; real-account acceptance is a separate consented session.
prs.scope: Shared evidence status and freshness; clear distinction between reported cost and lifetime contributions. Preserve Supabase-only auth and FolioKey tokens. Add safe error/freshness telemetry with no financial or identity payloads.
prs.gate: Owner isolation, anonymous rejection, atomic replacement rollback, duplicate commit, consent and missing values; desktop/mobile import review. Document existing exposed-key rotation separately; do not extend the temporary fallback in this track.
prs.rollback: Feature flag for new presentation; keep previous verified snapshot and current import contract.

prs.title: Canonical events, provenance and reconciliation
prs.now: Can implement against synthetic fixtures now; production migration stays unapplied pending review.
prs.scope: Append immutable purchase/redemption/switch/dividend/fee/transfer events with original source references and corrections. Exact scheme + plan + option + owner-scoped folio identity. Decimal amounts/units; no guessed opening cost. Quarantine conflicting duplicates, unmatched switches and incomplete opening history. Snapshot replacement must not erase the ledger.
prs.gate: Two identical legitimate transactions survive; overlapping statements deduplicate; corrections replay; transfer/split carry cost only with evidence; unmatched sells block affected performance/tax; source units reconcile within documented precision.
prs.rollback: Additive shadow tables and read flag; old snapshot import remains usable. No automatic backfill from invented legacy purchase dates.

prs.title: Mobile-led consent connection, provider chosen after eligibility review
prs.now: Provider interface and fake-provider tests can be built now; live activation is blocked on contracted access and verified coverage.
prs.scope: Supabase user owns each connection. Provider-hosted mobile/OTP/account-selection/consent; exact required inputs follow documented contract. Fetch → validate → canonical staging → review/commit. Verify webhook authentication, replay protection and server-side consent state; never trust redirect success alone.
prs.gate: Wrong/expired OTP, cancellation, consent expiry/revoke, partial AMC coverage, repeated callback and delayed response. Never promise all accounts from mobile alone. No PAN/OTP in logs; no provider secret in browser.
prs.rollback: Disable connection flag; retain consented CAS upload. Stop scheduled retrieval on revoked/expired consent.

prs.title: Offline CAS parser pilot
prs.now: Research candidate only; separate dependency/native-code review before installation or execution.
prs.scope: Evaluate codereverser/casparser behind canonical import contracts in an isolated local worker using synthetic documents. Review MIT and transitive/native notices; do not replace the paid provider or assume identical output schemas.
prs.gate: Encrypted/corrupt/oversized PDFs, timeout and memory limits, summary versus detailed statements, no raw PII persisted, no unapproved egress. Independent source reconciliation.
prs.rollback: Experiment stays outside production build; omit dependency if gates fail.

prs.title: Transaction-backed return engine and dated NAV store
prs.now: Pure calculations and synthetic history tests now; live history ingest only after data rights/coverage review.
prs.scope: Store source, retrieval time, NAV date, effective scheme mapping and revisions. Portfolio money-weighted return uses dated external flows plus terminal value; fund and portfolio boundaries treat internal switches differently. Historical valuations require units at each date; no guessed backward charts. Label absolute gain, realized gain, unrealized gain and contributions distinctly.
prs.gate: Hand-verifiable cashflows and independent solver cross-check; no root/multiple roots/non-convergence; terminal valuation date, dividends, full redemption, leap days and internal switches. Reject stale/conflicting/future NAVs; no silent forward fill or plan merge.
prs.rollback: Return unavailable with reason; no fallback to estimated returns or fabricated chart.

prs.title: Comparable fund cohorts and explainable underperformance
prs.now: Contracts and fixtures now; production analytics await licensed point-in-time category/benchmark histories.
prs.scope: Use matching plan/option/category and effective dates; suitable total-return benchmark where licensed. Fund NAV time-weighted comparisons differ from investor XIRR comparisons; a cashflow-matched benchmark is needed for the latter. Version original windows/thresholds and publish reasons. Unrated is not bad.
prs.gate: No look-ahead/survivorship bias; closed/merged funds and category changes represented; short history and mixed benchmarks abstain. Validate windows/weights on held-out history before labels influence decisions.
prs.rollback: Disable labels/ranking; retain transparent measured values with evidence coverage.

prs.title: Dated underlying-security exposure
prs.now: Engine fixtures now; live calculations require permitted holdings disclosures and security master.
prs.scope: Original documented weighted common-holdings measure; distinguish common-name count, pairwise overlap and portfolio-weighted security exposure. Keep cash, derivatives, foreign holdings and unknown coverage separate. Multi-level funds need cycle detection and explicit depth limits.
prs.gate: Identical/disjoint/partial holdings, duplicate securities, different disclosure dates, fund-of-fund loops and incomplete totals. Missing holdings must never produce reassuring 0% overlap. No copied competitor thresholds.
prs.rollback: Hide incomplete metric with coverage reason; keep simple AMC/category observations.

prs.title: Original monthly review with evidence changes
prs.now: Report schema/UI with clearly synthetic fixtures now; scheduled production jobs wait for prior engines and operational review.
prs.scope: Immutable in-app review: coverage, contributions versus growth, changed exposures, benchmark context and unresolved issues. Show within-criteria/monitor/review/insufficient states with versioned reasons. Discipline checks require a verified expected schedule and complete ledger; no assumed missed SIP.
prs.gate: Idempotent month/job key, no report on stale data disguised as current, correct month-end dates, repeated-run reproducibility and alert deduplication. Email/push only after separate opt-in and delivery configuration.
prs.rollback: Disable scheduling; retained reports remain dated historical records.

prs.title: Suitability and explicit planning scenarios
prs.now: Original forms and scenario contracts now; personalized recommendations wait for verified inputs and operating-model review.
prs.scope: Separate capacity/tolerance/liquidity/horizon; version answers and allow correction. Scenario assumptions are user-visible, not forecasts. Rank only eligible comparable funds from verified features; show sensitivity and why excluded. Prefer contribution-based rebalance options before taxable actions.
prs.gate: Incomplete/contradictory profiles abstain; zero/negative contributions and short horizons; goal funds not double-counted; no guarantee or universal best-fund claim; held-out recommendation evaluation.
prs.rollback: Planning stays informational; recommendation flag off; no order generated.

prs.title: Date-versioned tax lots, exit loads and direct/regular scenarios
prs.now: Interface and synthetic cases now; rules require current authoritative verification and independent specialist review.
prs.scope: FIFO where applicable, original acquisition/carryover evidence, grandfathering and rule effective dates. Distinguish gain estimation from user-specific tax liability. Include costs/lock-ins and cost of switching; never assume fee differential guarantees equivalent future performance.
prs.gate: Rule-boundary dates, missing basis, transfers, partial redemption, lock-ins, exit-load schedules, fund classification and user tax assumptions. Reconcile supported cases to independent statements.
prs.rollback: Withhold tax/switch estimates when unsupported; preserve original lots and source references.

prs.title: Order intent boundary without live execution
prs.now: Architecture/readiness spec only until provider, business eligibility and separate launch review exist.
prs.scope: Separate observation → scenario → recommendation → user-confirmed order intent. No broker scraping, credentials harvesting, payment routing or real order calls in this track.
prs.gate: Explicit confirmation, suitability/cost visibility, idempotency and settlement reconciliation requirements documented. Never infer transaction permission from portfolio-read consent.

prs.title: Evidence-bound explanations after deterministic engines
prs.now: Typed evidence envelope and offline evaluation plan now; no model/provider call in this track.
prs.scope: Generate language only from approved calculation/evidence records carrying method version, as-of dates and limitations. Jev remains optional research triage until its use is validated. No raw CAS, PAN, OTP or unrestricted database tools supplied to a model.
prs.gate: Exact numeric/source fidelity; abstention on missing evidence; prompt-injection and stale/conflicting-input tests; redaction; provider outage fallback to deterministic prose. No autonomous trade or unsupported best-fund claim.
prs.rollback: AI flag off; deterministic findings remain available.
